phase_name: Mechanical Class Guard for Future Callers

objectives.description: Classify invocation sites (genuine vs mention), re-derived not hardcoded
For each genuine caller, assert structural wrap
Assert deploy-headless.sh itself satisfies the same rule
Self-test the guard against a deliberately-unwrapped scratch copy

approaches_tried.approach: quote-parity veto computed relative to the first 'deploy-headless.sh' text occurrence
approaches_tried.reason: the genuine cycle-plan/gate-out invocations also quote their own path argument (e.g. bash "$SCRIPT_DIR/deploy-headless.sh"), which produced a false odd-quote-count veto misclassifying both genuine sites as mentions

approaches_tried.approach: quote-parity veto computed relative to the full anchor+command REGEX MATCH (BASH_REMATCH[0]), trying the punctuation anchor (bash-2, `(;&|{`) before the assignment anchor
approaches_tried.reason: the punctuation anchor's bare `(` alternative greedily matched the `(` inside gate-out's own `"$(bash ...)"` command substitution, producing a truncated match that started mid-string and re-introduced the same false veto for command-gate-out.sh specifically

approaches_tried.approach: try the assignment anchor (always ^-anchored at true line start) FIRST, falling back to the punctuation anchor only when the assignment anchor does not match
approaches_tried.reason: eliminates the mid-string match; both genuine sites now match with an empty prefix (vetoes correctly bypassed) while every real mention line (validate-state.sh's parenthetical remedy text, and 14 others) is still correctly vetoed or fails the anchor test outright

notes: Classification result (printed by the lint, auditable): exactly 2 genuine caller files (orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh line 870, command-gate-out.sh line 192) out of 194 scanned .sh files across agent-system/extensions/*/scripts/** (excluding tests/), 15 mention-only files. Matches research's claim of exactly two genuine sites. Structural verification: all three files (the two callers plus deploy-headless.sh itself) pass. Self-test: a deliberately unwrapped scratch copy of orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh correctly fails verify_wrap. Deterministic across 3 runs, 7/7 pass each time.
